overhead.method: autocannon drives each scenario at the mock provider directly and through the gateway (both in their own processes, loopback); the mock answers after a fixed 100 ms time to first token and streams 500 tokens at 1000 tokens/s. Each connection is one stream with a fixed request rate below what it can complete directly; latencies are corrected for coordinated omission with that intended interval. Added time is the gateway percentile minus the direct percentile; CPU and RSS are the gateway process's; RSS per 100 streams is its peak growth during the run above its size just before it, scaled to 100 streams. The gateway runs examples/policy with every budget level enforced at a limit the load never reaches, no rate limits, guardrails on, traces written and metrics kept.

headroom.note: session-aware reserves the same as worst-case here: the estimator is not given the session's previous cache read share yet (src/policy/decide.ts passes none), and the route sets no reserveOutputTokens.
